surface.pick: Pick a chat on the left, or press Message next to a friend.

notConfigured.title: Chats are not switched on
notConfigured.text: This build of JKNet has no JKNet Online service to keep chats on.

signedOut.title: Sign in to chat
signedOut.text: Chats live on JKNet Online. Sign in on the Settings screen to talk to your friends.

noChat.title: Chats are not available yet
noChat.text: The JKNet Online service does not have chats yet. They appear here as soon as it does.

failed.title: Chats could not be loaded
failed.text: Something went wrong while reading your chats.

list.offline: Reconnecting. Messages are sent once the connection is back.
list.noServerChat: No server chat right now. It appears while your private server runs and is deleted when it stops.
list.empty: No chats yet. Press Message next to a friend on the Friends screen to start one.

system.serverStarted: The server chat started. It is deleted when the server stops.

thread.gone: This chat is no longer available.
thread.emptyText: Say hi to {{name}}. Messages and files are kept for 90 days.
thread.emptyServer: Talk to everybody on your private server. This chat is deleted when the server stops.
thread.retention: Messages and files are kept for 90 days.
thread.retentionServer: This chat is deleted when the server stops.
thread.historyHidden: You joined later. Earlier messages are hidden.
thread.historyHiddenGroup: The group creator can turn on “New members see history” for people who join after that.
thread.historyHiddenServer: The host can turn on “New members see history” for guests who join after that.
thread.readOnly: Read-only: you are no longer friends

notify.allHint: Notify me about every new message
notify.mentionsHint: Notify me only when somebody mentions me or replies to me
notify.muteHint: No notifications; mentions still notify you

reply.missing: The original message is no longer available

reactions.limit: You can add up to three reactions to a message

reasons.fileNotReady: a file has not finished uploading
reasons.fileGone: a file is no longer available
reasons.fileTooLarge: a file is larger than 25 MiB
reasons.quotaAccount: your 1 GiB of chat files is full
reasons.quotaStore: the service has no room for files right now
reasons.hashMismatch: a file changed while it was uploading
reasons.sizeMismatch: a file changed while it was uploading
reasons.network: JKNet Online could not be reached
reasons.rateLimited: too many messages, wait a minute
reasons.notFound: the chat is no longer available
reasons.internal: JKNet Online has a problem, try again later

composer.tooLong: A message can be up to {{max}} characters long.
composer.notFriends: You are no longer friends. The chat is read-only; once you are friends again, it picks up where it left off.
composer.deletedPeer: This account was deleted. The chat is read-only and is kept until the 90-day limit.
composer.readOnly: You cannot send messages to this chat.

attach.limits: Up to 25 MiB per file. Files are kept for 90 days.

cards.unknown: Update JKNet to see this card.

emoji.title: Emoji
emoji.failed: The emoji could not be loaded.

link.title: Open a link to {{host}}?
link.body: Links in messages are written by other players. Check the address before you open it in your browser.

removed.account_deleted: The chat with a deleted account was removed
